title: The Horseback Riders
description: Two horseback riders prepare for the "Just Jumpers Horse Show" at the Three County Fair in Northampton, Massachusetts. The event is the oldest continuously operating agricultural fair in the United States and sees thousands of attendees annually. The fair hosts several horse competitions, including the New England Morgan Horse Show, where visitors can watch everything from carriage driving to ranch work.
translated_description: 两位骑马者正在马萨诸塞州北安普敦的三县博览会上为“跳跃者马术表演”做准备。该博览会是美国历史最悠久、持续运营的农业博览会，每年吸引数千名参观者。博览会举办多项马术比赛，包括新英格兰摩根马展，游客可以观赏从马车驾驶到牧场作业的各种项目。
